profile.headline: Software Engineer ll at Pilot Flying J
profile.summary:
I am Software Developer with great experience in Python, Web development using Django/Flask. 

Programming Languages: Python, JAVA, C, C++
 Web Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript 
Web Technologies framework: Django, Flask. 
Cloud Computing: Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, Amazon Lambda  
Database: MySQL, SQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL. 
IDE: JetBrains PyCharm, Eclipse EE, NetBeans.

positions.title: Software Engineer ll
positions.description:
Designed and maintained relational databases using PostgreSQL, and developed RESTful APIs using Python (Flask, SQLAlchemy) to support a fuel dispatch management application, enabling efficient scheduling, tracking, and coordination of fuel distribution operations.
Built and enhanced web application features using Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, and jQuery, delivering responsive UI components and improving overall user experience. Developed dynamic dashboard functionalities using Python, Bootstrap, and JavaScript frameworks, ensuring efficient data visualization and interactive user interfaces.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Flask and SQLAlchemy within a microservices architecture, enabling modular and scalable application development. 
Developed and deployed AWS Lambda functions using Python to automate workflows and event-driven processes, improving system efficiency and reducing manual intervention. Utilized AWS services including EC2, S3, Redshift, VPC, CloudWatch, and Elastic Load Balancer to build and deploy scalable cloud-based solutions, including data ingestion pipelines for JSON processing.
Optimized PostgreSQL queries, functions, triggers, and cursors based on business requirements, improving database performance and enhancing ETL processing efficiency and memory utilization.
Managed API deployment and system architecture using high-performance HTTP servers and AWS infrastructure, ensuring high availability and reliability. Maintained version control using Git, enabling collaborative development, code tracking, and efficient release management.
Integrated AI/LLM-assisted workflows into the development lifecycle, utilizing tools for code generation, testing, and documentation, improving development velocity and reducing time-to-delivery while adhering to best practices for responsible AI usage and data security.
positions.insights: Skills: CSS3 · HTML5 · SVN · JavaScript · AWS Lambda · PostgreSQL · pytest · Shell Scripting · HTML · JSON · Web Services · Bootstrap · Flask · RESTful WebServices · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · SQL · Jira · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and operated distributed, event-driven microservices using Python, Kafka, and Kubernetes across multi-node cluster environments, enabling scalable processing of high-volume, compute-intensive workloads.
Built and optimized large-scale data processing pipelines using Spark and Hadoop, leveraging distributed computing and storage architectures (HDFS) for batch and real-time execution. Worked with PySpark for distributed data processing, enabling scalable transformation and analysis of high-volume datasets.
Designed and managed workload execution patterns, including batch job scheduling, streaming pipelines, and resource-aware processing across distributed systems.
Collaborated on cluster-level performance tuning, improving resource utilization, throughput, and latency across compute workloads.
Implemented monitoring and observability solutions using Elasticsearch, Kibana, and Prometheus to track cluster health, job performance, and system reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Django · Panda · Airflow · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Jira · Oracle Database · kafka

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project Description : Worked on a HUM device project.

Designed, developed, and maintained full-stack web applications using Python (Django), delivering scalable and high-performance solutions. Built responsive and reusable UI components using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, improving user experience and frontend consistency.
Developed and integrated RESTful APIs to enable seamless communication between frontend and backend systems. Designed and managed data models and relational databases (MySQL), optimizing queries for performance and scalability.
Built asynchronous, API-driven microservices using FastAPI and asyncio, improving system throughput and enabling efficient handling of concurrent requests in distributed environments.
Built and maintained ETL pipelines using SSIS, Kafka, and Flume, enabling real-time and batch data ingestion from multiple sources into distributed systems (HDFS). Applied Test-Driven Development (TDD/BDD) practices using PyUnit, ensuring high code quality and reliability.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Docker, enabling automated testing, deployment, and faster release cycles.
positions.insights: Skills: Robot · Git · Q-test · Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Jira · Cassandra

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Project Description: Worked on a project to develop an internal application is a security and compliance automation platform focusing on User Group Reaccreditation and Database Account Reaccreditation as well as fleet security and compliance management.

Designed and developed scalable web applications using Java, Python, and JavaScript, ensuring high performance and responsiveness across distributed systems.
Implemented dynamic image rendering microservices consumed by JSP and REST APIs, leveraging AJAX, JSON, and AngularJS for real-time client interactions.
Built and maintained containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes, supporting distributed application deployment across multi-node clusters. Developed and optimized database solutions using MySQL and PostgreSQL, improving data retrieval performance and query efficiency.
Built CI/CD pipelines with Git and Jenkins to automate Docker container builds and deployments on AWS EC2 and Kubernetes and Used PyTest for comprehensive unit and integration testing, enforcing code quality and maintainability. Contributed to system performance optimization and reliability improvements through monitoring, load balancing, and efficient resource usage.
Developed REST Microservices which are like API’s used for Home Automation. They also keep the data in synchronization between two database services.
positions.insights: Skills: Java Script · Postgresql · HTML · JSON · Django REST Framework · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · HTML Scripting · jQuery · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed the application utilizing Python on Django Web Framework.  
For the development of the user interface of the website used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
Experience in developing views and templates with Python and Django view controllers and templating language to create a user-friendly website interface. 
Built S3 buckets and managed policies for S3 buckets and used S3 bucket and Glacier for storage and backup on AWS. Created scripts in Python which integrated with Amazon API to control instance operations 
Modify the existing Python/Django modules to deliver a certain format of data.   
Experienced in handling large datasets using Partitions, Spark in Memory capabilities, Broadcasts in Spark, Effective & efficient Joins, Transformations and other during ingestion process itself. 
Optimizing existing algorithms in Python using SparkContext, Spark-SQL, Data Frames and Pair RDD. For the development of the web applications utilized CSS and Bootstrap.  
Designed and developed data management system using MySQL. Wrote python modules to extract/load asset data from the MySQL source database.  
Build SQL queries for performing various CRUD operations like create, update, read and delete.  
Skilled in using Collections in Python and Spark for manipulating and looping through different user defined objects.

projects.description: Provide security between clients for secure chatting. Used DES(Data Encryption standard) algorithm for Encryption and decryption using JAVA and Python.
